name: muscle-memory
description: Browser extension that gives Figma back your browser's shortcuts, a real right-click, and a wheel that scrolls the way you expect.

scripts.check: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && for f in src/*.js test/*.test.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && npm test
scripts.package: rm -f muscle-memory.zip && zip -r muscle-memory.zip manifest.json src icons -x '*.DS_Store'
